# Skillshare

> > Skillshare is an online learning community offering thousands of creative classes taught by industry professionals and passionate creators.

Skillshare provides creative education across design, illustration, photography, video, freelancing, and more. The platform connects learners with expert instructors and features coverage in major media outlets including Forbes, ABC7, and The Everygirl.
